Yes — that's exactly the safeguard I wanted. I'd filtered down to two results, hit "Select all 2 results," and the action bar said two selected, not three. So "select all" clearly means everything in the view I'm actually looking at, and it left the hidden third one alone. That's just right — when I've narrowed things down, acting on "all of these" should only touch what's in front of me, never quietly reach into the rest of my library. Good.

That covers the "apply to the whole filtered set" half of what I asked. The other piece from last round — the reverse bulk actions, so I can also bulk-mark-unread and bulk-remove a label, matching what I can already do to a single card — I don't think we've seen yet. Could we handle that next?
